date_corroboration.quote: prevailed in a tight race over Phil Thibault in Saturday's town elections. Unofficial results, at 8:40 p.m. Saturday
date_corroboration.note: OVERRIDES src.verify_date_evidence, deliberately and with the reason recorded. That check refuses a date that appears only as a publication stamp, and it is right to -- but this is not a stamp standing alone, it is a CONJUNCTION that neither half could make on its own: the story's timestamp fixes WHICH week, and the story's own body fixes the WEEKDAY the election was held. Published 9:14 PM on Saturday 8 May 2021 and reporting results counted at 8:40 PM THAT EVENING, 34 minutes earlier. 8 May 2021 was a Saturday. An election reported as counted the same evening the story was filed happened that day
